name: LogicalDOC
description_en: LogicalDOC is a browser-accessible document repository with metadata, search, content check-out/check-in and version history. Community Edition is separately offered under LGPLv3 with community support, while Business, Enterprise and hosted Cloud have distinct commercial terms and features. The documented Version, File Version and editable Revision are different identifiers. Evaluation should name the edition and deployment before relying on workflow, permissions or recovery behavior.
description_zh: LogicalDOC 是通过浏览器访问的文档库，提供元数据、搜索、内容签出签入和版本历史。Community Edition 单独采用 LGPLv3 并由社区支持，Business、Enterprise 及托管 Cloud 则有不同商业条款和功能。文档中的 Version、File Version 与可编辑 Revision 是不同标识。评估应先确定版本和部署，再确认流程、权限及恢复行为。

core_features.name_zh: 区分元数据与文件版本
core_features.explanation_en: Metadata edits increment Version while FileVersion changes with new file check-in.
core_features.explanation_zh: 元数据编辑增加 Version，新文件签入才改变 FileVersion。

core_features.explanation_en: Inherited rights track a referenced folder until locally applied and unlinked.
core_features.explanation_zh: 继承权限持续跟踪所引用文件夹，直到本地应用并解除链接。

core_features.explanation_en: Owned tasks progress through named transitions; review need not change lifecycle state.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所有者任务通过命名转移推进，审阅不一定改变生命周期状态。

en: Evaluate a synthetic supplier certificate with separate metadata/file versions, reviewer rights and a recoverable destination.
zh: 通过模拟供应商证书评估独立元数据文件版本、审阅权限及恢复目标。

Deployment.zh: CE、客户服务器商业版本及托管 Enterprise Cloud 有不同许可支持范围。

sections.title_en: Select the edition before defining a repository record
sections.title_zh: 定义库记录前先选版本
sections.en:
LogicalDOC’s free CE is a separately licensed and supported offer. The commercial comparison has distinct Business, Enterprise and Cloud columns; its image-only entitlement markers were not treated as reliable textual confirmation. The requirements identify Cloud as hosted Enterprise. The common online guide describes capabilities, but a guide entry alone does not establish that a particular CE or purchased edition includes a workflow, connector or backup module.

For a proposed pilot, use a fictional supplier quality certificate with a supplier ID, certificate number, expiry date and responsible reviewer. Identify the exact installation and requested features, then decide what makes the certificate acceptable and discoverable. A folder display or indexed icon does not prove its business metadata is correct. Use synthetic documents and an ordinary reader separate from the administrator. No installation, supplier record or document was created.
sections.zh:
LogicalDOC 免费 CE 具有独立许可和支持方式。商业对比列出 Business、Enterprise 和 Cloud，读取器中的纯图标权益未当作可靠文字确认；系统要求将 Cloud 定义为托管 Enterprise。通用在线指南介绍能力，但有某个主题不证明某套 CE 或所购版本包含流程、连接器或备份模块。

建议试点用虚构供应商质量证书，设置供应商标识、证书号、到期日和审阅责任人。先明确安装版本及所需功能，再定义证书何为合格、何为可发现。文件夹显示或索引图标不证明业务元数据正确。应使用模拟文档，并将普通读者与管理员分开。本研究未安装或创建供应商及文档。

sections.title_en: A metadata update is not a new file revision
sections.title_zh: 元数据更新不是新的文件修订
sections.en:
Content editing requires Write permission and uses a checkout lock, local modification and upload/check-in cycle. Other users can read while the owner edits. Signing off a local editor is not the same as checking in the chosen file. Bulk editing has additional Java/Webstart and configuration requirements, so browser access alone does not establish that desktop helper availability.

The version guide distinguishes Version, changed by metadata or content, from File Version, changed by checking in a new file. The separate Revision property is editable. For the fictional certificate, correcting its expiry metadata and replacing the scanned certificate are different events even if both change a displayed revision-like value. Record the actual file/version and review outcome. A configured Max Versions limit removes older entries; promotion of an old version is documented, but exact metadata/workflow reset behavior was not established. No file or version operation was performed.
sections.zh:
内容编辑要求 Write 权限，并经历签出锁、本地修改及上传签入。所有者编辑时他人可读取；关闭本地编辑器不等同于签入指定文件。批量编辑另有 Java／Webstart 及配置要求，仅可用浏览器不证明桌面助手也可用。

版本指南区分元数据或内容都会改变的 Version，以及新文件签入才改变的 File Version；独立 Revision 属性还能手动修改。虚构证书修正到期元数据与替换扫描证书是不同事件，即使两者都改变类似修订号的显示。应记录真实文件版本及审阅结果。Max Versions 限额会删除较旧条目，文档提供旧版提升，但精确元数据及流程重置未确立。本研究未操作文件或版本。

sections.title_en: Apply rights, propagate rights and inherit rights differ
sections.title_zh: 应用、传播及继承权限不同
sections.en:
Folder security separates Read, Preview, Download, Print, Write, Delete, Workflow and other actions. Apply Rights persists local choices, whereas Apply to Sub-folders propagates them. Inherit Rights links a folder to another selected folder, so later policy changes in that referenced folder are replicated; applying rights locally unlinks it. This is materially different from a one-time permissions copy. The admin group always has full permissions.

For the pilot, identify whether the certificate folder should follow a supplier folder’s changing policy or retain independent settings. Check an ordinary reviewer’s actual preview/download and editing rights after a controlled change. Do not use an administrator’s successful read as proof the intended employee or external recipient can access it. Multi-group precedence and all connector-specific enforcement were not tested. No group, folder, membership or security setting was changed.
sections.zh:
文件夹权限区分 Read、Preview、Download、Print、Write、Delete、Workflow 等动作。Apply Rights 保存本地选择，Apply to Sub-folders 才向子文件夹传播；Inherit Rights 会链接另一个选中文件夹，今后引用文件夹的权限变化继续复制，应用本地权限才解除链接。这与一次性权限复制明显不同。admin 组始终有完整权限。

建议证书文件夹需明确是跟踪供应商文件夹的动态政策，还是保留独立设置。受控修改后应用普通审阅身份检查预览下载和编辑权限，不以管理员成功读取证明目标员工或外部接收方可访问。多组优先级及各连接器执行未实测。本研究未改组、文件夹、成员或安全设置。

sections.title_en: Complete the task rather than only receiving its email
sections.title_zh: 完成任务而非仅收到邮件
sections.en:
The workflow guide defines tasks and transitions and notes that review may occur without changing a document’s lifecycle state. SMTP configuration supports notification. A participant may first need to take task ownership, then choose a named transition to advance it. For the certificate, specify the accepted expiry period, rejection path and responsible decision-maker; a notification or task appearing on a dashboard is not a completed review. The edition must separately include the needed workflow capability.

Integration uses SOAP/MTOM or REST, with version-specific API references. Current API-key guidance says keys act in their user’s name and legacy credential authentication was deprecated from9.0. Keep each application’s intended identity and document metadata mapping explicit. A proposed test should reconcile the created certificate and its fields before any workflow handover; authentication alone does not establish that import, indexing and review all succeeded. No key, endpoint, email or workflow task was operated.
sections.zh:
流程指南定义任务和转移，并说明审阅可不改变文档生命周期状态，通知则依赖 SMTP 配置。参与者可能需先取得任务所有权，再选择命名转移以推进。证书需明确接受的到期范围、拒绝路径及决策人；收到通知或仪表板有任务不等于审阅完成，所选版本也需包含必要流程能力。

集成使用 SOAP／MTOM 或 REST，并有专版 API 参考。当前 API 密钥指南说明密钥代表所属用户，9.0 起弃用旧凭据认证。每个应用应明确身份与文档元数据映射。建议测试先核对创建的证书和字段，再交接流程；认证成功不证明导入、索引及审阅都成功。本研究未生成密钥、调用端点、发送邮件或操作任务。

sections.title_en: Restore an object into an intended location
sections.title_zh: 将对象恢复到明确目标位置
sections.en:
Copying creates a new document unrelated to the original, while moving changes its location. Deletion places documents in trash; the guide says Restore places the element into the currently selected folder. It does not promise return to the original folder or prove the destination’s effective permissions. Choose the destination and verify the restored certificate’s identity and access. Trash retention and permanent-purge timing for a specific installation remain unknown.

The optional LogicalDOC Backup module is a separate recovery path. Its restore guide explicitly warns that restoration destroys the current installation before attempting recovery. It is not a convenient per-file undo. Plan a recovery environment and verify backup completeness before considering that procedure; no restore commands are supplied or run here. A downloaded certificate or copied folder is not established as a full application, database, version and workflow backup.
sections.zh:
复制会创建与原件无关联的新文档，移动则改变位置。删除将文档放入回收站；指南规定 Restore 将对象恢复到当前选中文件夹，不保证原文件夹，也不证明目的地实际权限。需选定目的地并核对恢复证书的身份和访问。特定安装的回收站保留及永久清理时点未知。

可选 LogicalDOC Backup 模块是另一条恢复路径，其指南明确警告先销毁当前安装，再尝试恢复，并非方便的单文件撤销。考虑该程序前应规划恢复环境并验证备份完整；本文不提供或运行恢复命令。下载证书或复制文件夹尚未确立为包含应用、数据库、版本及流程的完整备份。

sections.title_en: Keep Cloud recovery objectives separate from local administration
sections.title_zh: 区分云恢复目标与本地管理
sections.en:
The cloud backup policy states daily application/configuration backups retained thirty days and weekly backups retained three months, with a separate backup region. It describes RPO of24hours and RTO of24businesshours for critical production systems, qualified by customer SLAs. These are policy objectives, not a demonstrated individual-file recovery time or a guarantee of zero loss. A current order must establish the region, recovery request and exact responsibilities.

Customer-server deployment needs its own resources and operational plan. The current requirements list JDK25 and supported server/browser environments and warn that size depends on concurrency and repository volume. Do not apply that commercial installer’s minimum hardware or every old helper instruction to a CE release without checking its own package. The Cloud terms also restrict ordinary accounts to the customer’s employees and route support through a designated administrator; an external-facing collection use case needs explicit entitlement. No server, backup, Cloud account or support request was operated.
sections.zh:
云备份政策规定应用配置每日备份保留三十天、每周备份保留三个月，并置于独立备份地区。对关键生产系统描述 RPO24小时、RTO24个工作小时，同时受客户 SLA 限定。这是政策目标，不是实测单文件恢复时间或零丢失保证。当前订单仍需明确地区、恢复申请及责任。

客户服务器部署需自有资源与运维计划。当前要求列 JDK25 及受支持服务器浏览器，并说明容量依并发和库规模变化；不能未核对 CE 自身包，就套用商业安装器最低硬件或旧助手指令。Cloud 条款还将普通账户限于客户员工，并经指定管理员提供支持，外部收集场景需明确权益。本研究未操作服务器、备份、Cloud 账户或支持请求。

sections.title_en: CE freedom does not license every commercial edition
sections.title_zh: CE 自由许可不覆盖所有商业版本
sections.en:
The actual CE license identifies LGPLv3 and explicitly allows commercial/noncommercial copy, adaptation and redistribution under its conditions. CE is free software with community support rather than a limited commercial trial. The commercial EULA separately limits internal use to paid users and installation scope and restricts code redistribution/OEM use. Consequently the family-wide open-source flag remains unknown while the CE-only grant is recorded explicitly.

Business, Enterprise and Cloud use a quote form asking for users, repository size and country; no public numerical commercial amount was adopted. Budget separately for the exact edition, infrastructure or hosting, backup module, migration, integrations and support. The Cloud fee text describes nonrefund and order-dependent charges; current cancellation notice, export window and precise renewal behavior were not established. Do not derive unlimited paid production rights from a free download link. No quote, trial, license acceptance, installer download or payment was submitted.
sections.zh:
实读 CE 许可指明 LGPLv3，并明确在条件下允许商业及非商业复制、改编和再分发。CE 是由社区支持的免费软件，不是限期商业试用。商业 EULA 另按付费用户及安装范围限制内部使用，并限制代码再分发和 OEM，因此全家族开源标记保留未知，同时明确记录仅 CE 的授权。

Business、Enterprise 和 Cloud 通过要求用户、库容量及国家的表单报价，未采用公开商业数值费用。应另预算版本、基础设施或托管、备份模块、迁移、集成和支持。Cloud 费用文字有不退款及按订单收费条件，当前取消通知、导出窗口及准确续费行为未确立。免费下载安装入口不产生无限付费生产权益。本研究未提交询价、试用、许可接受、安装器下载或支付。
